name: M87 image reconstruction from calibrated VLBI observables
method: Apply independently developed CLEAN and regularized maximum-likelihood imaging pipelines to calibrated VLBI observables; assess robustness with blind teams, synthetic-data reconstructions, parameter surveys, and cross-method comparison.

parameters.published_procedure: Two-stage imaging procedure described in EHT Paper IV
parameters.stage_1: Four teams worked blind using CLEAN and regularized maximum-likelihood methods
parameters.stage_2: Synthetic datasets and parameter surveys were used to select and test imaging configurations
